name: Number Systems Diagram
description: Interactive Mermaid flowchart diagram mapping the hierarchical classification and properties of real and complex number systems.
learningObjectives: Identify the nested relationship among natural numbers, integers, rational numbers, and real numbers in the diagram
Classify a given number such as -3, 2/5, or the square root of 2 into the smallest number system that contains it
Explain why every integer is a rational number but not every rational number is an integer
Locate the definition of each number system by clicking its node to jump to the matching page section

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive visual modeling with step-by-step exploration and immediate feedback
keyQuestions: What mathematical relationship is illustrated by this model?
How does changing one variable or parameter influence the outcome?
commonMisconceptions: Confusing visual scale or orientation with underlying numeric operations
assessmentOpportunities: Explain the displayed relationship in student's own words
Solve an algebraic problem and confirm result with the interactive model

title: Number Systems Diagram
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Algebra I
Number Systems and Properties
Hierarchy

learningObjectives: Understand the structural taxonomy of real and complex numbers through a hierarchical node diagram.
prerequisites: Introductory familiarity with variables and algebraic expressions
